evidence_basis: Static official code and asset audit at RoboTwin c3ddfa8
Historical fvl05 base smoke: one planner failure followed by success on next seed
Historical Mouse fresh-scene and finite-attempt engineering evidence, used only as cost prior
GPU4-7 runtime environment, scene, and first action probes completed; retained failures included

family_specific_overrides.F1: stop the root if any active block is not independently graspable or a non-target block exceeds the proposed audit displacement bound
family_specific_overrides.F2: stop if the exact same object/model ID/arm cannot satisfy all three relations; no substitution by branch
family_specific_overrides.F3: stop if either single V or single H fails realized-motion/continuity before attempting V->H
family_specific_overrides.F4: stop if one neutral-to-neutral block fails return continuity or damages an already completed slot predicate

retryable_failures: transient scene initialization failure with complete cleanup
bounded recovery explicitly listed by family
non_retryable_failures: grasp continuity loss during F3 event
failure_terminal_rules: Every attempt writes a terminal status and failure code.
No retry may change asset ID, candidate program, arm, scene seed, verifier semantics, or threshold.
Timeout, unexplained state drift, or orphan process is terminal for the current probe/run and requires review.
review_requirement: Replace low-confidence wall-time ranges with measured probe/Stage0 evidence before approval; this proposal does not authorize Stage 0.
